title: Autopilot setup answers
description: Answers for `autopilot setup --config <file>`. With --yes, setup runs without prompts and fails on a missing answer it needs. Secret values are never in this file.

app_id.description: ID of an existing GitHub App to use. Without it, setup creates a new App in the browser, which --yes cannot do.

workflows.description: Let the agents change GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/). A person still reviews each such pull request. Setup gives a new App the Workflows permission. For an existing App without it, setup tells you how to add it. Default: true.

app_key.description: Absolute path of the private key file (.pem) of the App in app_id. Host setup pushes it to a host that has no key. Default: ~/.config/autopilot/app-key.pem, where autopilot app create saves it.

host.description: Name of a host in the hosts file, SSH target of the host (for example user@my-host), or local for this machine. Setup saves the host in the hosts file. Default: --host, else AUTOPILOT_HOST, else the default host of the hosts file.

name.description: Name to save the host under in the hosts file. Default: --name, else the name of the host if it is in the file, else the host part of its SSH target (for local, the short hostname). A name has letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-", starts with a letter or a digit, and is not local.

owner.description: GitHub login that may start jobs, written to a new host.json. Default: the login of gh.

allow.description: Accounts and owner/repo entries that the host watches.

init.description: Repos (owner/repo) to onboard with autopilot init. Setup skips a repo that already has .github/autopilot.json.

alias.description: Shell alias for autopilot (for example ap), or false for none.
